scope: Lift tier probe: a 2 kg, 0.35 x 0.45 x 0.88 m light cabinet held at its top front edge by palm-object fixed joints (grasp abstraction; hand/wrist collisions with it filtered) starts ~2 cm above the floor at the crouch start. IK raises both palms 6 cm under GR00T Balance, GR00T Walk carries it for 5 s at the reviewed 0.2 m/s, Balance holds while the palms lower to 2 cm below the start pose to set it down, then the joints are disabled at runtime and the palms return to the start pose to test release. 3 kg would exceed the 5 Nm wrist pitch limit at this grasp.
